cohort: 94 pregnant women with severe preeclampsia and eclampsia (48 in the Pritchard regimen group and 36 in the Dhaka regimen group).
finding: The low-dose Dhaka regimen of MgSO4 was as effective as the standard Pritchard regimen in controlling convulsions in women with severe preeclampsia and eclampsia.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not statistically significant between the two treatment groups.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported in the abstract
